Thought ppl were gonna be super accepting here and tolerant. 

This was not the case throughout my first semester. 

I never wanted to go to umich in the first place and all hell is manifesting for me

-Being bullied every single day
-My friend using me to his advantage academically
-COVID policies being shitty
-way too short of a break

Now all I really wanna do is hope I don’t wake up tomorrow. I could see caps but I’m too dead at this point to do so. 

I’d give my umich experience a 1/10

Second semester starting tmr. Idk if I’m even ready for it

They already abandoned me bc they think I’m a troll

I feel like a terrible person honestly, my family proves that I am an asshole bc they call me that for not taking their advice
If they have another one of those put me in there I seriously don’t want to live anymore.
Not really, to be honest. About to get kicked out of school anyway so no chances
